Random inputs are fixed: rnd(name, n) = the first n bytes of keccak256("scaas/pqvault/vectors/<name>/0") ‖ keccak256("scaas/pqvault/vectors/<name>/1") ‖ …; the labels are in the generator. Source: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-17-pqvault.md (§5.2–§5.4, §5.15, §6) and docs/contracts/pqvault.md. UNAUDITED. Item versions (spec §6.4, §6.6, §6.8). r = rnd("r/<name>", 16); okm = HKDF-SHA-256(ikm K_v, salt r, "scaas/pqvault/v1/item" ‖ vaultId ‖ epochId ‖ itemId ‖ be32 version ‖ author, 44); bk = okm[0:32]; n = okm[32:44]; aad = abi.encode(vaultId, epochId, itemId, uint32 version, author, homeChain, address homeVaultContract) (224 B, the vault's home); pt = pad(UTF-8 json) to 256, 1,024, 4,096 or 16,384 B (at most 16,384); ciphertext = r ‖ AES-256-GCM-SIV(bk, n, pt, aad), 32 to 16,416 B; json = canonical JSON of content (keys sorted, no whitespace). record: the records.json row whose ciphertext this is (batchIndex: its index in the batch). file: kFile = HKDF(K_v, "scaas/pqvault/v1/file" ‖ vaultId ‖ epochId ‖ itemId ‖ be32 version), usage KeyWrap; content.keyWrap = nonce ‖ AES-256-GCM-SIV(kFile, nonce, file key, aad "scaas/ua/v1/keywrap" ‖ u8 Data (2) ‖ vaultId ‖ epochId ‖ itemId ‖ be32 version). refusals: rows against the base item, one change each (the ciphertext, an AAD field, the key): CiphertextLength, Padding, AeadOpen. padItemLimit: padItem takes at most 16,380 B of content (the 16,384-B bucket).
